summary: Tested both backend (daily-games ranking + /games/play hook) and frontend (login, daily ranking podium, MiniPlayer audio persistence flows). All 6 backend tests passed. All 5 frontend audio persistence flows passed: minimize keeps audio & shows MiniPlayer, mini-player-open returns to room, Salir keeps audio, mini-player-leave disconnects, red ✕ leave-room-btn fully disconnects. Daily ranking podium visible with Melvin_Live as #1 (4,000) and correct 3M/2M/1M labels.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows fallback text '🎙 Sala activa' instead of the actual room name (e.g., 'Test Room 1775928775'). Either loadRoom's joinRoom(roomId, r.data.name, user.id) update is racing the first minimize click, or AudioContext.joinRoom only calls setActiveRoom on successful Agora join (line 63), so a transient failure leaves activeRoom null and the first successful re-join uses empty roomName. Consider: setActiveRoom({roomId, roomName, userId}) before awaiting client.join so the UI reflects the room context even during 'connecting' state, and/or update setActiveRoom inside the roomName-sync branch even when clientRef.current is currently null.

On the 1st-place podium card the username 'Melvin_Live' appears in the DOM text content but visually seems clipped/covered by the avatar (screenshot shows only '4,000' and '+3M'). The other two slots show 'Vacante' + 'Juega ya' labels. Consider adding a min-height or moving the username below the avatar with explicit spacing so it is always rendered.

issues: Multiple 'Failed to load resource: 404' errors appear in the console on every page load (resource name obscured by browser). Not blocking but worth investigating.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Fix MiniPlayer showing 'Sala activa' fallback: in AudioContext.joinRoom, call setActiveRoom({roomId, roomName, userId}) BEFORE awaiting client.join so the room name appears even while Agora is still connecting / if Agora fails. Also ensure the roomName-sync branch (line 40-42) runs even if clientRef.current was cleared by a previous error.

(Optional/low priority) In the Daily Ranking podium, ensure the winner username text is always rendered visibly above the amount — currently avatar overlaps/covers the name on the 1st-place tile on 390px viewport.
Investigate repeated 404 resource load errors in the browser console on Dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: AudioContext.joinRoom only sets activeRoom after a successful Agora client.join. If the backend /agora/token call or Agora join fails, activeRoom stays null and the MiniPlayer never appears — users who fail to connect audio get no feedback. Consider setting activeRoom on 'connecting' and cleaning up on 'error'.

games.py:record_daily_win increments games_played even when both winnings=0 AND bet=0 are guarded early, which is correct; however the same helper is called both from play_generic losses and wins — confirm that games_played counter matches product expectations (currently increments on every bet>0 call).

RoomView.js line 74 hard-codes roomName='' on initial mount then relies on the polled loadRoom (3s interval) to backfill the name via joinRoom — causes a visible 'Sala activa' fallback flash. Fetch room name synchronously (pass from Dashboard) or block the first joinRoom until loadRoom returns.

Dashboard.js daily-game-ranking uses loose indexing `[1,0,2].map(slotIdx => leaderboard[slotIdx])` — correct mapping (2nd on left, 1st center, 3rd right), but relies on array order from backend; ensure backend always returns rank-sorted.
